svg.title: AiTM attacker infrastructure
svg.desc: A victim client in the cyber range clicks a lure URL that resolves through a wildcard DNS record to an Evilginx reverse proxy running on a separate attacker VM. Evilginx relays the real sign-in flow to and from Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, capturing the victim's credentials and session cookie in transit. The attacker then imports that cookie into their own browser to access Microsoft 365 as the victim without needing MFA again.
